issue.title: Full-run failure recorder must drop xdist worker-crash node IDs
issue.description: FullRunFailureRecorder (tests/_test_selection_health.py and its pytest plugin) records pytest node IDs from failure reports without validating that they resolve to a real repo test path. When an xdist worker crashes, pytest can emit a CollectReport whose nodeid is the bare worker ID (e.g. 'gw22') rather than a test path. The selection-health store at HEAD holds exactly such a 'gw22' entry, which find_false_negatives then treated as an excluded test file and reported as a false negative -- corrupting the metric with a non-test artifact. FullRunFailureRecorder should filter out (or the correlator should ignore) any recorded node ID that does not resolve to an actual repo test path. Proposed by epic sase-fp's land phase (sase-fp.8.3); discovered during sase-fp.8.2 (Change-scoped false-negative correlation).
